text: Kasia's birthday is next Tuesday. She mentioned she's been getting into pottery, so a voucher for a wheel class would probably go down well.
Lunch with Obi today. He starts at the new firm on Monday and is a bit nervous about the commute. Remind me to text him Monday evening to see how the first day went.

Vanessa and Luca are having a housewarming on Saturday from 7pm. They've finally moved into the place on Elm Road after months of the sale falling through. Luca's mum will be there, and Vanessa warned me she asks everyone about their love life. Apparently they still have no sofa, so it's a bring-a-cushion situation. I'm getting the train, so leave by 6.
Anders told me he's retiring at the end of next month after 32 years at the council. His wife is planning a surprise do for him.
Dentist moved to Thursday at 10:15. Need to pick up the dry cleaning on the way back.
Noor got the promotion! She's now head of operations. I should send her flowers this week.
Mehmet's dinner party on Friday is off, his daughter has chickenpox. He said we'll rearrange once she's better.
Chioma loves anything to do with Studio Ghibli. Her favourite is Kiki's Delivery Service.

Call with Tunde this morning. His last day at the bank is a week on Friday and the leaving drinks are at the Crown afterwards, from about half 5. Don't forget to chip in for the card and present, Gemma is collecting.

Esme is having a really rough time at the new job. Her manager keeps piling things on and she's not sleeping much. She said she's thinking of quitting before Christmas but is worried about money, since her partner Obi is between contracts too. Should check in with her over the weekend, maybe suggest a walk on Sunday.
Ayo's son Kofi turns six on Sunday. Dinosaurs are still the big thing, apparently.
I'm bringing dessert to Adriana's on Saturday night. Probably a tiramisu.
Remind me to ask Karan how the interview went on Wednesday. It was for the product manager role at Wang & Partners.
Zofia's mum is turning seventy in a fortnight and the whole family is going to Kraków for the weekend to celebrate. Zofia is in charge of the cake and is stressing about it.

Bumped into Lachlan at the station. He's been made redundant, they're closing the Leeds office. He seemed fairly upbeat about it but I'd like to take him for a pint soon. He's got a payout coming and is talking about using some of it to finally do the West Highland Way in the spring. His kids are both at uni now so he says the timing is oddly good.
Sam (Samantha, not Sam from football) has a dog called Biscuit who is turning one tomorrow. She's throwing it a party, genuinely.
Emil and his partner Mia are hosting a games night on the 14th at 8. I said I'd come.
Need to buy a birthday card for Dad before Friday.
Vikram started at the hospital trust yesterday. He said the induction was mostly fire safety videos but the team seem lovely.
Gemma mentioned she's been eyeing up a new e-reader, the Kobo one with the coloured screen. Her birthday is in early December. Worth remembering.
Arjun's leaving do was last night. Must message him tomorrow morning to say thanks for organising it and good luck in Singapore.
Caitlin's brother Connor got into the fire service. Their mum is over the moon. Caitlin said he starts training in January.
Dinner at Nasser and Suzanne's next Thursday at 7:30. Suzanne is vegetarian and Nasser can't do dairy, so if I bring anything it has to be vegan.
Mateo is really into vinyl at the moment, mainly old soul and funk records. He's after a decent pair of speakers too.

Spoke to Dawit on the phone. His dad retires on Friday after forty years as a bus driver, and they're doing a family lunch on Sunday at 1. Dawit's quite emotional about it. I should get a card for his dad and ask Dawit to pass it on.
Anika's birthday drinks have been called off because half the group has flu. She's going to do something smaller next weekend instead.
Kofi is nervous about his first day as a teaching assistant on Monday. Remind me to text him good luck on Sunday night.
Gym at 6:30 tomorrow morning, then the boiler engineer is coming between 12 and 4.
Aarav got the job at the architecture practice he really wanted! He hands in his notice at the café tomorrow.
Esme said her sister Noor is expecting in March. Their parents don't know yet so keep it quiet.
Chioma is hosting a Nigerian food night on the 22nd at 7. She's doing jollof and suya and asked everyone to bring drinks. Her flatmate is DJing, apparently.
Don't forget Uncle Vikram's sixtieth on Saturday. Mum wants us there by 2.
Mateo had his first week as a junior chef. He says the head chef shouts a lot but he's learning loads. He looked exhausted.

Luca's partner Adriana is turning forty on the 3rd. Luca wants to do a surprise dinner at that Italian place on Tuesday the 2nd and asked if I can keep the evening free. I said yes. He's also asked me to sort the cake, which I'm doing.
Mia is starting her PhD in October and moving to Glasgow. Her girlfriend is staying in Bristol for now.
Should ring Grandma on Sunday afternoon, it's been ages.
Obi's wife Kasia had her baby on Tuesday morning! A little boy, Tobi. Remind me to send something, maybe a babygrow and a card.

Gemma Brennan from work is leaving on Friday after eight years. There's a collection going round. She loves gardening and has been talking about getting a greenhouse. Her husband is retiring at the same time, and they're moving to Cornwall in the new year to be nearer their grandkids. I'll put in twenty quid and write something in the card on Thursday.
Lachlan told me he's been offered a promotion to team lead but isn't sure he wants it. He has to decide by next Wednesday.
Anders' granddaughter has her christening on Sunday the 9th at 11am. He's thrilled.
Ayo has been promoted to senior nurse. She was so happy telling me. I need to take her out for a celebratory lunch soon, maybe next Friday.
Zofia's cat Pierogi went missing on Monday night. Still no sign of him and she's devastated. I'll check in with her tomorrow evening.
Mehmet Banerjee is my new manager from next week. He's apparently big on cycling and does triathlons.
Karan and Noor are throwing a joint thirtieth on Saturday the 18th, starting at 8. Dress code is 'something gold'. I need to find something gold.

Talked to Connor after the match. His mum retires next month and he's trying to plan a party but his sisters can't agree on anything. He's a bit frazzled. One sister wants a quiet meal, the other wants a marquee in the garden with a band. Their mum just wants a new set of golf clubs, by the sound of it. Connor asked if I'd be up for helping with invitations next weekend, which I'm happy to do.
Book the car in for its MOT. Garage closes at 5 on Saturdays.
Suzanne said her husband just started a new job at a solar company and absolutely loves it. Their kids are thrilled he's not working weekends anymore.
Remind me on Thursday to ask Tunde how his last week went and whether he's found anything new yet.
Vanessa is doing her first presentation to the board on Wednesday at 2pm and she's terrified. Must text her Wednesday morning to wish her luck, and then call her in the evening to see how it went.
Kasia has a soft spot for fancy candles and anything lavender scented.

Sam's engagement party is next Saturday at the cricket club. Her fiancé Dawit is from Addis, so his family are flying in on Thursday. She asked if I could help set up from 4. I need to remember to bring the fairy lights and the extension lead. Also find out whether Dawit's parents speak much English, so I can at least learn hello in Amharic before Saturday.
Emil's last day at the agency was Friday. He's taking a month off before starting his own studio. Must remember to ask him in a couple of weeks how the studio plans are going.
Arjun is gluten free and doesn't drink. Keep in mind for the dinner.
Caitlin's housewarming was lovely. Her new place has a garden at last, and her little boy loved the swing.
Aarav's mum is coming out of hospital tomorrow after the knee operation. He's taking the week off to look after her.
Anika got into the choir she auditioned for. Rehearsals start next Tuesday evening.
Note to self: Mateo's birthday is the 27th, not the 29th. He's really into climbing so maybe a chalk bag or a day pass at the bouldering place.

Long chat with Esme tonight. Her brother Lachlan has been offered a job in Toronto and is flying out in a fortnight for a final interview. Their dad isn't well, so Esme is worried about him being so far away. She's also hosting Sunday lunch for the family this weekend and asked if I could come at 12 to help with the cooking. I should bring wine and maybe a pudding.

Nasser's retirement party is on Friday at 6 in the function room above the Red Lion. His daughter Zofia is giving a speech and is really nervous about it. Remind me to text Zofia on Thursday night to wish her luck.
Quiet weekend planned. Going to finally sort the spare room and maybe do a long walk on Sunday morning.
